benchmark_semantics: SELECT-only installed lookup benchmark, not enabled writer or continuous storage proof.

indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX ix_raw_dictionary_created ON public.raw_snapshot_dictionaries USING btree (created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_raw_snapshot_dictionary_scope ON public.raw_snapshots USING btree (source_id, parser_version, md5((source_url)::text), id) WHERE (http_status = 200)

Plans.Filter: ((created_at >= (date_trunc('day'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)) AND (created_at < ((date_trunc('day'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)) + '1 day'::interval) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)))
